history.note: Completed source+consumer inventory, taxonomy, package schema, and initial gap matrix. Calculator normalization now carries canonical taxonomy and package provenance metadata.
ProgramReleaseCatalogEngine now projects enriched spindle-capable machine profiles instead of a three-machine demo list.
MachineVocabularyNormalizerEngine — vocabulary normalization for controller, spindle, coolant, capability, and kinematics fields with fuzzy matching.
MachineConfidenceCalculatorEngine — field-level confidence scoring with 15 weighted rules, ambiguity queue management, and resolution workflow.
MachinePackageSelectionEngine — package-driven machine selection replacing heuristic filtering with confidence scoring, compare, and validate surfaces.

MachineCapabilitySurfaceEngine — controller capabilities, spindle packages, coolant strategies with 6 controller profiles, power curve generation, and capability comparison. 41 tests, 12 dispatcher actions wired.

ShopMachineOverlayEngine — persist user-owned shop machine profiles as overlays on canonical packages. Supports calculator presets, merged views, and downstream consumer binding. 27 tests, 8 dispatcher actions wired.

MachineOptionContractEngine — validates legal machine options preventing unsupported controller/spindle/coolant combinations from rendering. Contract tests enforce UI never shows invalid options. 38 tests, 6 dispatcher actions wired.

MachineConsumerBindingEngine — binds Program Release, Print to CNC, and quoting to canonical machine package + overlay model. Unified machine context for all consumers. 48 tests, 7 dispatcher actions wired.
MachinePackageAPIEngine — unified API surface for machine-package CRUD, capability queries, compatibility checks, validation, and coverage stats. 52 tests, 12 dispatcher actions wired.

MachineProfilePropagationEngine — propagates machine-profile into quoting, scheduling, feasibility, and what-if analysis. Quote estimates, scheduling contexts, feasibility checks, and machine comparison. 50 tests, 10 dispatcher actions wired.

CalculatorPRISMModeEngine — PRISM mode orchestration deriving best-fit tooling, holder, coolant, software, and toolpath from machine package. Material-aware recommendations, inventory matching, machine comparison. 47 tests, 5 dispatcher actions wired.

AcquisitionRecommendationEngine — tiered (budget/standard/premium) acquisition recommendations with ROI analysis, payback period, distributor info, purchase history tracking, and item comparison. 58 tests, 5 dispatcher actions wired.

MachineAuditEngine — brand audit waves for Okuma, Haas, Mazak, Brother, Citizen, DN Solutions, DMG MORI. Coverage scoring, field validation, gap identification, remediation tracking. 63 tests, 6 dispatcher actions wired.
